name: Camp Taurajo
summary: Camp Taurajo holds the eastern mouth of the pass into Mulgore. The tauren camp offers travelers an inn, supplies, mentors, and wind rider routes across the plains and central Kalimdor.

sections.title: Frontier of the Red Rocks
sections.body: At Camp Taurajo, you reach the eastern mouth of the pass into Mulgore. For young tauren leaving Bloodhoof Village, the camp is often their first glimpse of the wider Barrens. Dry scrubland and rugged mesas surround this outpost and trading hub. Hunters, leathercrafters, and field herbalists find shelter here, while wind riders connect the camp to Thunder Bluff, the Crossroads, and Freewind Post deeper south.

faq.answer: Camp Taurajo is a tauren settlement and outpost in the southern Barrens, between Mulgore and the Barrens' arid scrublands.

faq.q: Where does the road west lead?
faq.answer: The dirt trail west from Camp Taurajo crosses the mountain pass into Mulgore, toward Bloodhoof Village and Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Where do the wind riders from Camp Taurajo fly?
faq.answer: Wind riders from Camp Taurajo travel to the Crossroads to the north, Thunder Bluff to the west, and Freewind Post in Thousand Needles to the south.

angles.text: As a tauren leaving Mulgore for the first time, you find Camp Taurajo as the first friendly shelter on the Barrens' harsh plains.
As a member of the Horde, you can use Camp Taurajo's overland junction and flight path to connect Mulgore with the rest of Horde-controlled central Kalimdor.
